description.en: Activates (or repositions) a tornado hazard registered with CMND_BTL_REG_TORNADE, setting its position and optionally its strength/behavior parameter.
Handle of the tornado slot, from CMND_BTL_REG_TORNADE.
Optional strength/radius parameter (values of 300 or more mark it as a stronger tornado type).
True once the tornado has been activated/repositioned; null if fewer than 3 arguments were given.
